```javascript
export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'text_transform',
      description: 'Transform text using one of several modes.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          text: { type: 'string', description: 'Input text to transform.' },
          mode: { 
            type: 'string', 
            enum: ['uppercase', 'lowercase', 'slug'],
            description: 'Transformation mode.'
          },
          trim: { 
            type: 'boolean', 
            default: true,
            description: 'Whether to trim the input text.'
          }
        },
        required: ['text', 'mode'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

function slugify(text, trim) {
  let s = text;
  if (trim) s = s.trim();
  s = s.toLowerCase();
  s = s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
  s = s.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  return s;
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'text_transform') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  // Validate no extra inputs
  const allowed = new Set(['text', 'mode', 'trim']);
  for (const k of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(k)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${k}`);
    }
  }
  
  const { text, mode } = args;
  if (typeof text !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('text must be a string');
  }
  if (typeof mode !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('mode must be a string');
  }
  const trim = args.trim === undefined ? true : args.trim;
  if (typeof trim !== 'boolean') {
    throw new Error('trim must be a boolean');
  }
  
  let result;
  switch (mode) {
    case 'uppercase':
      result = trim ? text.trim().toUpperCase() : text.toUpperCase();
      break;
    case 'lowercase':
      result = trim ? text.trim().toLowerCase() : text.toLowerCase();
      break;
    case 'slug':
      result = slugify(text, trim);
      break;
    default:
      throw new Error(`Invalid mode: ${mode}`);
  }
  
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: result }]
  };
}
```
